answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 43776 Country: India Title: Haiz Question: If a fasting lady has started menstrual discharge (haiz) 1 or 2 hour before Iftar time, will her fast for that day is valid or not? Answer ID: 43776 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 330/L-155/TL=1434) If a woman experiences haiz in the state of sawm, her sawm shall be null, though the blood discharged before one or two hours of iftar. In such case the woman will have to do qaza of the fast after Ramadan. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
